title: Decomposition of Failure Factors for Baseline B0 and Countermeasure Family C

mechanism_1_subthreshold_blind_region.finding: Every attack pulse of Cycle A (A=0.4100) satisfies A < 0.4554 and E = 0.2634 <= 0.3350. Both overt penalty and slow-burn penalty boundary conditions fail to trigger.

mechanism_2_unconditional_recovery_branc.finding: B0 assigns all observations in R_sub to BENIGN_RECOVERY. An attack pulse of A=0.4100 receives the EXACT same positive trust recovery reward as a clean nominal packet of A=0.0500.

mechanism_3_memoryless_rehabilitation.definition: Contraction factor per rest step: (1 - alpha_0) = 0.7943. Over 10 rest steps: (1 - alpha_0)^10 = 0.0993.
mechanism_3_memoryless_rehabilitation.finding: 90.07% of any trust depression is erased within 10 rest steps. The 3D Markov state (T, E, SB) aliases with pristine devices after 10-28 rest steps, granting the adversary unlimited repeated rehabilitation.

factor_a_accumulator_reset.analysis: Family C does not use hard resets, but its exponential decay factor rho=0.95 erases 40.13% of accumulated pulse evidence over 10 rest steps (0.95^10 = 0.5987), actively dissipating the attack signal.

factor_b_detector_signal_amplitude.analysis: The single attack pulse A=0.41 produces an input of only 0.5693. Averaged over 11 steps, this yields an effective signal amplitude of 0.0518 per step, which is smaller than natural ambient variance.

factor_c_threshold_calibration.analysis: To prevent false quarantine of uncompromised devices under Edge-IIoTset telemetry noise (where 8.88% of packets are in the near-threshold band), tau_Q had to be calibrated to the 99th percentile (4.4364). Setting it lower causes catastrophic availability loss (as observed in Phase 4 M1/M2).

factor_d_recovery_dynamics.analysis: Family C left B0's underlying trust recovery dynamics unchanged. When Q <= tau_Q, trust recovers toward 1.0 unconditionally at full rate alpha_0. Because Q remained below tau_Q, Family C applied zero penalty during attack pulses.

factor_e_policy_timing.analysis: Trust and policy are evaluated synchronously per step. The attack pulse occurs when trust is at ceiling (T=1.0), immediately harvesting ALLOW before any degradation can manifest.

factor_f_insufficient_memory_across_epis.analysis: Family C has an effective memory horizon of H = 1/(1-rho) = 20 steps. It possesses ZERO memory across multiple completed rehabilitation episodes. Once an adversary rests for 20-30 steps, Family C's state completely forgets prior attack cycles.

factor_g_observation_level_confounding.analysis: Family C operates strictly at the OBSERVATION level, integrating anomaly score proximity. Because the marginal distribution and frequency of near-threshold packets in benign telemetry (freq=0.0888, mean=0.4006) match the Cycle A attack (freq=0.0909, mean=0.4050), observation-level filtering suffers an insurmountable signal-to-noise barrier.
